description: Search email. Combine free text with filters; all given filters must match. With several mailboxes and no account, searches them all.

account.description: Which mailbox to use. Defaults to the first. Pass the Mailbox shown in a list result when acting on that email.

has_attachment.description: Only with, or only without, attachments.

query.description: Free text across sender, subject and body.

name: search_emails
